recipe.title: Off to... London, Berlin & Amsterdam - Love and Lemons
recipe.description: We’re leaving next Wednesday and I would love love love your suggestions and recommendations if you live in or have traveled to one of these cities… Restaurants, markets, cafes, shops, galleries… some “not-to-miss” sights… some that are off the beaten path and a little less touristy. We’re also open to meeting up with some fellow bloggers if time allows. I’ve been to London a few times before and I’m excited to go back for more curry, and of course a stop at one of the Ottolenghi restaurants. Amsterdam & Berlin… I’m not so sure what to expect (especially for veggie food […]
